gripOrientationConvention: XYZW, targetSocketWorldQuaternion inverse multiplied by handBoneWorldQuaternion; targetWorld * sample = handBoneWorld; multiply socketQuaternionBoneLocal for handGripWorld. Verified against actual GLB Three.js sampling.

attention.jawNotes: Small weighted jaw opening; no phoneme lip synchronization. Runtime speech state owns playback.
attention.notes: No baked blink cycle; runtime owns gaze/blink timing.

limits: Three-role Jerusalem pilot passed finite sampled structural and actual GLB/runtime gates. WebGL integration was reviewed during the pilot; user visual review precedes extension to other islands. This is not a continuous all-triangle collision proof.
Adult CMU recording is retargeted; carrier and older character are authored role adaptations, not a captured carrier or elder.
Work geometry, object handling and planted turns are authored with recorded motion reference/timing; not captured ancient activity.
Layered authored cloth deformation has 2mm tunic/3mm mantle shells; not fabric simulation.
